design_philosophy: Premium enterprise consulting aesthetic. Executive minimalism, structured systems-inspired UI, elegant depth layering, strong mobile readability. Linear/Stripe Enterprise dark mode style, operationally mature, governance-oriented.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-semibold text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-medium text-white
hierarchy.small_label: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-[#E7B85C]

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Mobile-first approach. Desktop acts as an enhanced extension of the mobile experience. High priority on touch-friendly spacing and readability on mobile.
layout_and_spacing.grid_patterns: Asymmetrical structured grids on desktop. Use CSS Subgrid where applicable. Bento box layouts with 1px subtle borders (border-border_subtle) and dark surfaces.

surface_strategies.navbar: Sticky compact navbar, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#071120]/80, 1px bottom border border-white/5
surface_strategies.cards: Flat surfaces (#0F1B33), 1px subtle border (#FFFFFF/10), no heavy shadows, subtle hover elevation (-translate-y-1) and border color shift to interactive blue or gold.

buttons.primary: bg-[#E7B85C] text-[#071120] hover:bg-[#F0C879] font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-md transition-colors
buttons.secondary: border border-[#4D7CFE]/30 text-[#4D7CFE] hover:bg-[#4D7CFE]/10 px-6 py-3 rounded-md transition-colors

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky transparent navbar with scroll blur. Mobile hamburger overlay menu. Elegant secondary link styling for WhatsApp (no bright green buttons).

components.name: Hero Section
components.description: Cinematic enterprise headline. Abstract workflow/governance background visual. Two CTAs (Primary Gold, Secondary Blue outline).

components.name: Trust Metrics
components.description: Animated counters (200+ Teams Transformed, 98% Satisfaction, 50+ Coaches, 8+ Years, 500+ Profiles, 10+ Clients, 200+ Experts). Horizontal scroll on mobile to save vertical space.

components.name: Enterprise Consulting Services
components.description: 4 cards: Agile Transformation, PMO Consulting, Project Delivery Consulting, Specialized Project Resources. Use thin line icons (Lucide React).

components.name: Agile Transformation
components.description: Capabilities grid showcasing agile methodologies and transformation metrics. Use agile_transformation_visual.

components.name: PMO Strategy & Governance
components.description: Governance visuals and structured workflow diagrams. Use pmo_governance_visual.

components.name: Specialized Project Resources
components.description: Accordion component (Shadcn UI) containing 9 resource types. Must feel like premium specialized consulting, not a staffing board.

components.name: Why Enterprises Partner With Us
components.description: 8 points presented in a structured, asymmetrical grid. Use enterprise_systems_graphic as a supporting visual element.

components.name: Flexible Engagement Models
components.description: 5 cards detailing engagement structures. Minimalist, high contrast, clean typography.

components.name: Consultation Form
components.description: Premium dark form using Shadcn UI Form/Input/Select components. Conditional dropdown logic.

components.name: Footer
components.description: Minimal premium footer, large typography for 'Let's Talk', LinkedIn link, copyright. Large padding (py-24).

motion_and_interaction.rules: Subtle fades, staggered reveals for lists/grids, smooth transitions. No heavy parallax or scroll hijacking. Hover elevation on cards.

media.icon_style: Thin line icons, stroke-width: 1.5, text-[#E7B85C] or text-[#4D7CFE]

image_urls.description: Abstract enterprise systems and workflow graphics, glowing gold lines on deep navy.
Structured grid with subtle gold and blue data points.
Dynamic moving elements converging into structured form.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use placeholder images. Use ONLY the provided media URLs.
Ensure all interactive elements have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on their role.
Implement mobile-first design strictly. Test horizontal scrolling on Trust Metrics for small screens.
Use Sora (or equivalent) for headings and Inter for body text via Google Fonts.
Build standard interactive elements (Accordions, Forms) using Shadcn UI primitives, customized to the locked color palette.
Avoid generic stock imagery, handshake photos, or AI robot visuals.
Ensure the background color #071120 is applied globally.
